title: Klippo Prebuilt Complete Prompt Catalog
source: Pre-rendered complete prompts from current subcategory variations and existing eight presets.

presets.cinematic: Realistic cinematic commercial, controlled soft light, natural shadows, one smooth motivated camera move.
presets.minimal: Clean studio, balanced soft light, negative space, restrained product-focused movement.
presets.lifestyle: Believable everyday setting, natural light, realistic product interaction.
presets.dynamic: Strong opening, energetic controlled pacing, one clear action, clean cuts.
presets.luxury: Premium lighting, refined contrast, controlled highlights, elegant framing.
presets.flatlay: Tasteful overhead or angled flat lay, deliberate spacing, soft shadows.
presets.creative_reveal: Reveal through framing, focus, light or camera movement; never transform the product.
presets.white_doodle: Thin white 2D doodles trace only visible product contours/details; never obscure the item or add captions.

prompt_variants.10:
VIDEO PROMPT — 10s | 9:16
PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Cinematic product commercial with a motivated, fluid camera move and natural depth.
MODEL: No human or animal model. Use only the display arrangement supported by the reference; do not invent a hanger, mannequin, accessories or extra pieces.
SCENE: Restrained menswear studio with crisp natural side light. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Start on the visible collar or neckline, then pull back to reveal the garment's complete proportions. 2–6s Track down the front placket or central seam only if visible, preserving buttons and stitching exactly. 6–8s Finish with a level full-product frame and sleeves and hem unobstructed. 8–10s Finish with a full-product hero frame: collar-to-fit reveal, complete and unobstructed. Use a continuous, motivated camera move and let the product detail emerge naturally.
CAMERA: One smooth dolly or shallow arc; preserve perspective and garment proportions.
LIGHTING: Soft directional key light, gentle fill and natural shadows; retain source colours.
AUDIO: Restrained instrumental music below any selected voice; fabric rustle only when visibly caused. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Product-first commercial with thin white 2D doodles tracing only visible contours or construction details.
MODEL: Animals are not appropriate for ordinary human apparel. Do not add an animal or put this garment on one; only depict animal apparel if the reference itself clearly shows an animal garment.
SCENE: Clean background, realistic texture and controlled highlights. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Reveal the complete item and establish its position. 2–6s Open on the full garment, then push toward a real cuff, sleeve opening or seam shown in the reference. Slide along the sleeve toward the shoulder; add no watch or accessory; keep all lines thin, white and subordinate to the garment.  6–8s Ease into a stable transition frame. 8–10s Hold that exact position briefly for the next clip. During the detail beat, add one thin white contour trace around a visible edge, seam or pattern; never cover the product or add words.
CAMERA: Slow stable push or lateral slide so the product remains readable.
LIGHTING: Clean even lighting with accurate garment colour and clear edges.
AUDIO: Light playful instrumental music at low volume; no spoken words by default. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 3-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Creative reveal through framing, focus, shadow or camera movement; the product never transforms.
MODEL: One adult human model may wear or present the garment naturally, with a small turn or relaxed step only if it helps show visible fit. Preserve cut, length, colour and print; add no unsupported accessories.
SCENE: Soft directional light and neutral colour rendering. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–4s Reveal the garment from a slight side angle, then track toward the front to show its true shape. 4–13s Make a slow vertical pass from shoulder to hem, keeping width and length consistent. 13–23s Hold on the complete outline without cropping. 23–30s Finish with a clean, steady hero frame: structured silhouette. Reveal the product through a clean foreground slide or focus change, never by morphing or fabricating objects.
CAMERA: Foreground-edge reveal, rack focus or controlled slide, then show the entire item clearly.
LIGHTING: Shape the reveal with realistic light and shadow while preserving original colour.
AUDIO: Subtle modern instrumental music; no magical transformation sounds. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
PRODUCT FIDELITY: The supplied reference is the source of truth. Preserve all visible cut, construction, colour, print, texture, labels and proportions. Invent no features, claims, accessories, logos or text.

PRODUCT: {PRODUCT_NAME}. Match the supplied product image exactly; preserve its real identity and appearance.
STYLE: Minimal studio product film with generous negative space and restrained pacing.
MODEL: No human or animal model. Use only the display arrangement supported by the reference; do not invent a hanger, mannequin, accessories or extra pieces.
SCENE: Even studio light preserving the garment's original tone. Keep the background quiet and the garment readable; add no unsupported props, extra garments or product features.
ACTION: 0–2s Reveal the complete item and establish its position. 2–6s Start at the actual hem and tilt upward to reveal the garment's full length. Move closer to a naturally formed fold without fabric snapping or exaggerated motion.  6–8s Ease into a stable transition frame. 8–10s Hold that exact position briefly for the next clip. Keep the action measured and uncluttered; use stillness and negative space between moves.
CAMERA: Slow push, short lateral slide or locked-off framing; no unnecessary flourish.
LIGHTING: Broad balanced soft light with delicate shadows and accurate colour.
AUDIO: Quiet unobtrusive instrumental music; no unnecessary sound effects. No dialogue, captions, subtitles, watermarks or added text.
CONTINUITY: One continuous 2-part film. Match garment identity, scale, position, background, light direction, colour balance and motion direction across clips. No jumps, morphing, duplicates or sudden scene changes.
